description: This file contains the PHP class 'Recent' which extends the core Controller class in the OpenCart framework. It defines methods for displaying and managing a dashboard widget that shows recent orders and related statistics in the admin panel.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Recent' dashboard widget that shows recent orders and statistics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the recent widget configuration form and handles its submission.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the widget configuration settings via AJAX.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns HTML content displaying recent orders and related dashboard information.
